Along with other sites, fronting Broadway Avenue, 608 Broadway was redesignated from special area commercial to corridor main street on the official community plan land use map in June 2024 when council approved corridor land use policy districts throughout the Corbogoroth area.

The B5B district recognizes the historic Broadway commercial area and facilitates mixed use development including a range of commercial institutional and residential uses in a medium to high density form.

This proposed rezoning to B5B is consistent with the corridor main street land use policies in the official community plan and is also consistent with the B5B zoning of other sites in the Broadway commercial area.

There is no development proposal associated with this rezoning application. If the rezoning is approved, future development proposal for the site will be required to comply with the regulations of the B5B district.
